history.content: Hi, my phone has no signal at all—nothing loads, I can't send picture messages, and I can't get online or make a call. Can you help?

I can help you with this issue. First, I need to identify your account to check your line status and provide the right support. Could you please provide one of the following:

- Your phone number
- Your customer ID
- Your full name and date of birth

Once I have this information, I’ll begin troubleshooting your service problem.
My name is Sofia Martinez and my phone number is +1-617-555-0148.

Thank you for providing your information. Your line is currently active, so let's begin troubleshooting your service issue.

To help diagnose the problem, could you please check your phone's status bar and let me know what icons or messages you see at the top of your screen? For example, do you see an airplane icon, "No Signal," or any other indicators? This will help determine if the issue is related to airplane mode, signal strength, or something else.
I see the airplane mode icon, 'No Signal', and 'Data Enabled' at the top of my screen. It looks like airplane mode is on.

It appears that Airplane Mode is enabled on your phone, which disables all wireless connections—including cellular service, calls, texts, and mobile data. To restore your service, please turn off Airplane Mode.

Once you turn off Airplane Mode, check if your signal returns and if you can make calls, use data, and send picture messages. Let me know if your service is restored or if you still experience issues after turning off Airplane Mode.
Airplane mode is now OFF. However, I still don't have any signal bars and I can't make calls or use data.

Thank you for turning off Airplane Mode. Since you still have no signal, the next step is to check if your SIM card is being detected and working properly. 

Could you please check your SIM card status on your phone and let me know if it shows as active, missing, or locked? This will help determine if the issue is related to your SIM card.
I just checked, and my SIM card status says it is Locked.

A locked SIM card will prevent your phone from connecting to the network, which explains why you have no signal or service. This usually happens if the wrong PIN or PUK code was entered multiple times.

To resolve this, you’ll need to unlock your SIM card. Your phone should prompt you to enter a PIN or PUK code. If you know your SIM PIN or have your PUK code, please enter it as prompted.

If you do not know your PUK code or are unable to unlock your SIM, please let me know, and I can guide you on the next steps.
I don't know my PUK code, so I can't unlock the SIM. What should I do next?

I’m unable to provide your PUK code directly. For your security, you will need to contact customer support by phone or visit a store with your ID to retrieve your PUK code and unlock your SIM card.

Would you like me to transfer you to a human agent who can assist you further with retrieving your PUK code?
